workspace.description: Discover project facts and gate a federation workspace; --require-complete turns incomplete evidence into a policy failure.

completeness.check: One-project offline analysis of config, imports, and on-disk artifacts; weaker without emit/manifest facts.
completeness.emit: Post-emit adapter facts (manifest, stats, emitted assets) when MFDoctor runs in the bundler after build.
completeness.probe: Explicit deployed-manifest validation and optional remoteEntry HEAD; never downloads or executes remote JS.
completeness.runtime: Offline correlation of a user-supplied Observability export with local project facts; never fetches URLs from the trace.
completeness.workspace: Cross-project federation gate over discovered .mf/doctor/project.json facts; does not invent missing emit evidence.

githubAction.name: workspace-federation-gate
githubAction.pinToTag: Pin uses: to a release tag (for example @v1.1.0). Do not pin to @main for production workflows.

nonGoals: HTML report UI or interactive web dashboard
In-browser MFDoctor runtime agent or client-bundle injection
MCP server schema or tool surface
No network command (including compare and probe) unless explicitly requested
Scraping private Module Federation plugin internals
Runtime-only Module Federation without a bundler MF build plugin
